images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a painted FROST CAST VFX animation sprite sheet, square 1254 × 1254 canvas, exactly 2 columns × 2 rows of equal square cells, four frames in row-major order. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff. Do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or grid. Pure uniform BLACK #000000 background, bright energy only: an additive emission plate. Every effect centred exactly in its own cell with generous black padding; no glow or particle touches a cell boundary. Hand-drawn painted 2D animation, confident hand-drawn edges with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes, restrained texture, readable small silhouettes and no conspicuous grain. No photographic mist, neon laser style or fire-like flames. Frames 4–7 of 8, the release and fade of the same flare: top-left frame 4 the flare bursts outward, 44%, shards flying outward; top-right frame 5 the burst breaks into scattering shards with a shrinking core, 38%; bottom-left frame 6 faint fragments and a dim core, 24%; bottom-right frame 7 a few tiny fading sparks, 10%, mostly black. Same effect, fading. Blue-white and deep-blue energy only. No floor shadows. The percentages describe effect size within each cell, maintaining generous black padding. No labels, no borders.
